title: ubiqX AI — “Onde foi parar o seu dia?” (launch film, draft A)
angle: A — problem → reveal: a one-second visceral hook (the workday drawn as a bar that drains), two quick pains (context switching, Friday timesheet from memory), a caret alone in silence, the logo on the drop, then the core loop on the real UI (registra → classifica → revisa → entrega), proof (your AI or IA do Ubi, privacy, 3 systems) and the end card.

conventions.frames: Scene-relative frames unless marked 'abs'. Every scene start is a multiple of 15 (a beat); the drop (240), the features-act clicks (660, 780, 840, 1020, 1140, 1200) and the final hit (1320) are downbeats (multiples of 60).
conventions.transitions: Not overlapping: a transition is split into an outgoing half inside the end of scene N and an incoming half inside the start of scene N+1, with the same type in N.transitionOut and N+1.transitionIn; 'frames' = the frames of that half inside that scene (0 = the half is empty). The cut frame is the boundary.
conventions.camera: Screen primitive with width 1440 for 2880-px captures; 'zoom' is the Screen camera zoom, effective bitmap scale s = zoom × 0.5; on-screen UI text = capture text px × s (capture text px measured from the PNGs: cap/descender height ÷ 0.73–0.95). 'atFrame' = the frame the camera ARRIVES; 'duration' = travel frames before it (default 24). 'anchor' = where the target lands on the canvas (default centre). 'focus' = explicit image point when the hotspot's own centre is not the aim.
conventions.cursor: 'atFrame' = arrival frame; a key with click:true clicks on that frame (arrival 3–4 f earlier on the previous key). 'to' is a hotspot of the scene's capture, or 'rest:x,y' in composition px for fade-in/rest points.
conventions.sfx: 'atFrame' = the frame the HIT (transient / loudest point / hit_offset) must land, relative to the scene; anchor 'start' marks risers placed by their start (their end_is_downbeat lands on the next downbeat). Cues that straddle a cut (whooshes, whips, risers) are mixed on the master audio track, not inside the scene's <Sequence> (which would truncate them). gainDb is relative to the bed's nominal level (BED = 0.5).
conventions.reading: hold ≥ max(24, 2 × chars) from the landing frame (last word at spring ≥ 0.9) to the exit frame, exits snapped to beats. Lines shown together are also checked on their sum from the later landing; sequential cards (one replaces the other) are checked individually. UI bitmap text is not 'copy' — its legibility is covered by the ≥ 36 px zoom rule in camera.uiTextOnScreen.
conventions.typography: Sora 600/700/800 + Inter 400/500/600 only; PT-BR accents kept; NBSP glue shown as U+00A0 in the copy strings; brand casing ubiqX / UBI / IA do Ubi.

music.key: A minor (relative C major) — the SFX library's pitched sounds are C-major pentatonic / A4 riser ends / C6–E6 dings, all diatonic here
music.tempo: 120 BPM, 4/4, beat = 15 f, bar = 60 f; downbeat of bar 1 on frame 0
music.style: Modern electronic / tech-pop: tight four-on-the-floor kick, round sub, plucked arp motif A–C–E–G, airy pads; no vocals. Mix so it works muted-first: the picture tells the story, the music sells the hits.

sections.name: Vazamento (intro under water)
sections.description: Whole section through a ~900 Hz low-pass (render a filtered stem). Filtered kick on 1 and 3, a dry clock-tick hi-hat motif in 16ths (the time leaking), Am9 pad, sub on A1. Bars 3–4: low-pass opens 900 → 2.5 kHz, snare roll 8ths from abs 180, 16ths from abs 210. Stops dead at abs 225 — no reverb tail, no pickup.

events.note: First downbeat ON frame 0 (poster frame): filtered kick + sub A1 + muted Am9 stab. No silent lead-in.
Clock lands 18:00 in s01: tick motif stops for one beat; the downlifter SFX takes over.
Cut to s02 (chaos chips).
Slam '“Só um minuto.”' on beat 2: muted bass stab; bed ducked −5 dB (impact).
Counter lands on '40 min': low piano A1+E2.
SFX riser-2bar enters (natural end would be abs 240); it is hard-muted at abs 225 with the bed.
Low-pass opens over bars 3–4 while the timesheet scene plays; snare build.
Hard stop of bed AND riser (2-f fade max) — the cut to the lone caret.
Pre-reveal silence abs 225–239 (15 f, 0.5 s). Nothing plays.

sections.name: Drop — revelação
sections.description: Full range from abs 240: kick, sub, clap on 2 & 4, open hats, wide supersaw Am chord stab; the loudest bar of the film, then settling into energy 4 by bar 7 as the lead motif enters.

events.note: Logo slam: the hardest downbeat (crash + sub). SFX impact_deep_2 + sub-boom stack on it; bed duck −6 dB.
Zoom-through into the product: crash + chord change to F; the whoosh peaks on this frame.
Lead pluck motif A4–C5–E5 enters as the hero window floats.

sections.name: Groove A — captura e classifica
sections.description: Main groove: bass 8ths, plucked arp, claps. Leave room (no melodic notes) on the frames where SFX hit.

events.note: Headline 'Ele registra. Você trabalha.' (cut hidden by the same framing).
A 1-bar rising hi-pass sweep follows the timeline wipe (450→510).
Pluck C6 with the 18:00 landing (ding_2 = C6).
Whip cut into 'Regras, memória, IA.'
Pluck A4 — 'Regras,'
Pluck C5 — 'memória,'
Pluck E5 — 'IA.'

sections.name: Groove B — revisão
sections.description: Groove variation: counter-melody + percussion layer; builds to the biggest features-act hit on abs 840.

events.note: Variation starts (the review queue).
Cut to the keycap.
1-beat drum drop abs 735–749 (bass + pad only) so the key-down SFX sounds alone.
Drums re-enter on the match cut (short reverse cymbal ending exactly on 750).
Rule chips appear.
'Confirmar os 19' click: crash + chord lift Am→C — peak of the features act.

sections.name: Respiro — 18:00
sections.description: The breather before the proof: drums thin to kick-on-1 + shaker, pad opens, bell motif. Calmer motion on screen (UBI nods, the report reveal).

events.note: Drums thin out; pad swells (UBI nodding).
Bell E6 with the 18:00 landing (ding_1 = E6).
Soft hit: the report window rises.
Pluck with the 'Copiar Markdown' click.
Whip into the proof act (beat 3); a 1-beat snare pickup 1035–1049 is welcome.

sections.name: Prova — build
sections.description: Groove returns lighter, builds over bars 21–22 into the final hit.

events.note: Hover beats on the provider pills (1065/1080/1095).
'IA do Ubi' click: full drums back.
Mask contact ana@example.com → [email].
SFX riser_1bar_1 (ends on A4 at 1320) + snare 16ths build under the platforms.

sections.name: Final — end card
sections.description: Final hit, then no more drums: one sustained C(add9) chord with a slow pluck echo, decaying; the tail closes before the last frame.

events.note: Final hit (kick + sub + crash), resolving the A-minor film to C major; bed duck −4 dB.
Soft pluck with the CTA click.
Tail: low-pass closes, reverb decays.
Last audible sample ≤ frame 1499 (no fade needed); the picture holds the end card to the end.

music.loudness: Master −14 LUFS integrated (±1), ≤ −1 dBTP. Short-term: problem act ≈ −18 LUFS (filtered), drop and features ≈ −12 LUFS — the dynamic range sells the reveal.
music.stems: Deliver: full mix, a low-passed copy of bars 1–4 (or the filter automated in the mix), and the music without the drop crash (in case the SFX stack is enough).

issues: Bitmap upsampling above style §S11's 1.15 cap: s08 and s09 at 1.2, s10 and s13 at 1.25, the s11 and s12 button push-ins at 1.4. The app's UI text is CSS 13–15 px (26–30 capture px at DPR 2), so ≥ 36 px on screen needs s = 1.2–1.4. Mitigations already in the boards: the pressed buttons are live vector replicas and everything around them sits under a 0.62 spotlight dim. Clean fix: recapture review-settled-expanded, review-confirmed, review-queue-selected, review-after-assign, reports, settings-ai and settings-ai-ubi at DPR 3 (tools/capture-ui.mjs, newPage({dpr: 3})); hotspot rects scale ×1.5 and every zoom here drops to ≤ 0.94 bitmap scale (1.4 / 1.5).

Secondary UI text inside zoomed frames (category chips, origin badges, 'pendente', the rule chips) renders at 29–31 px; in each case the same word is carried by the kinetic headline landing on the same frame.

The captures themselves contain '1 – 9' (keys-legend, queue-row-active-hint) and model version ids (report-1-meta 'claude-sonnet-5', settings model-fields). The framings and solid scrims in s09, s10, s11, s12 and s13 keep them out of view; builders must not widen those framings. A cleaner fix is recapturing with a 1–5 legend if the product agrees.

Cues that straddle cuts (zoom-through whoosh at abs 300, whips at 540 and 1050, riser-2bar 120→hard-muted 225, riser_1bar_1 1260→1320) must live on a master audio track; inside a scene <Sequence> they would be truncated.

s06 needs Screen camera zoom up to 54 (override maxZoom 3.2) and a vector X (brand/ubiqx-wordmark.svg, path wm-X) aligned over the sidebar X; the image rect used (≈ x 202–228, y 98–130) is an estimate from the capture — measure it on a still before locking.

s11's match relies on 'Confirmar os 19' (review-settled-expanded, image ≈ 1785–2011 × 446–510) and row 1's 'você' badge (review-confirmed, ≈ 1830–1940 × 470–504) being ~50 px apart; verify on a still and add a 6-f position morph if the jump reads.

The hook's 08:00→18:00 clock is abstract and differently worded, but it echoes the existing trailer's '8 → 18' idea. If zero overlap is wanted, s01 can run 09:00→18:00; the 18:00 end must stay because it pays off in s12 (the report's default time).

No capture exists of the privacy card or the 'Dados enviados à IA' dialog, so s14 is a kinetic diagram built on the real redaction token '[email]'. A capture of that dialog would make a stronger proof shot.
